12 October 2026 — original government acquisition checkpoint.

Fixed XL: **233 catalogue-installed / 288 absent of 521**. Whole-map reporting: **346,108 source forms**, 4,516 enhanced forms and 6,649 native asset entries. Forms/assets are not unique physical buildings. The completed checks below add **zero installations**.

ROOT independently verified exact completed jobs on pinned Neon (billowing-surf-67227217 / br-icy-silence-b3wjwz0q / neondb), every referenced file hash and authoritative released reservations:

- **Upton original terrain/current-ring replay:** job `0514c963b8c79bae794a1bcd2683730f2af78788245e05434ce1a38f66d72427`, 8,262 references, pushed in `4c4462e1e`. The private candidate preserves all 8,164,251 exterior drawn facets and 841 old grid nodes; 1,247 actual sampler points report no errors. The unchanged terrain validator rejects overlapping height surfaces. This remains an unaccepted private candidate; the next bounded audit measures overlap provenance and full affected-actor regressions.
- **Southside oblique original-source review:** job `cbb783f6035b6e9acc36533325c4786ef2fa4846f9046c83786b6fc3cbc9258a`, 916 references, pushed in `6e160e85d`. ROOT inspected the actual full export. Source-specific wall/closure shapes are described without engineering/root inference.
- **Southside exposed source-edge reconciliation:** job `25155d8a5bbf4e4729955973bfd25e6c048d79d1840174c759751a1b3552243e`, 934 references, pushed in `4f6e59f3e`. Four original components have 8/11/6/2 genuine grade-to-exposed-subsegment-to-clear-cap paths across all four bindings. Every raw whole-edge failure and lower closure remains recorded; no unresolved steep path in those four components. Fifteen other source parts have terminal-placement review routes. These are authentic-source terrain findings, not current rendered-terrain or physical acceptance. Facets11034/3009 and complete remaining-body/current terrain obligations remain.
- Previous complete Upton whole-parent comparison, Southside grade/focused review and West Wing mounting/typed visual context remain unchanged and reusable in the committed handoff. West Wing body0 has a bounded ROOT source interpretation; its certificate and remaining typed graph must follow the existing positive-dimensional contact policy without adding a categorical interior-contact rejection.

**Next work:** Upton measured candidate overlap plus whole affected-actor clearance/seams; Southside exact source-role qualification followed by current terrain/foreign/native/runtime gates; West Wing current body0/remaining-body qualification. Completed unchanged finite/contact math is reused. Schema/import/serialization failures are preserved as orchestration failures, not model corruption.

Executor: Codex ROOT with the three existing user-requested acquisition agents. Acquisition skill `1.9.57`; ROOT verification notes and handoff are committed. Original government building geometry, 1× scale and placement remain unchanged; **zero AI geometry modelling**. No optimisation jobs, variants, approval or publication started. Full XL completion remains unproven; these issues stay open.

Current orchestration negatives: Upton’s next audit stopped before geometry work on a copied receipt-hash mismatch; a bounded pin repair is being prepared. West Wing’s certificate post-freeze audit failed because its stdout log was frozen while still growing. The full exit1 stream and exact historical prefix are preserved; a separate receipt-only recovery must literal-verify its own complete scope before reuse. Neither failure changes source geometry or installation counts.
